第两千二十七章 蝴蝶公子（第1页）
龙凤文明海之间，各路修士云集，仿佛一场巨大的盛会一般。
放眼看去，那一片黑暗海洋之中，起码来了三四十万的修士，热聊之声，嗡嗡响彻了一大片。
宝藏宫的修士，这一次和剑界修士一起过来。
有着黑暗领主，至诚剑帝，混沌子，三个领主压阵，根本不存在任何的风险。
除了一桌一床和桌上的五个储物袋，以及隐隐约约护住储物袋的秘阵，舱内没有别的东西。房玉昆令手下人将隔壁舱内的三个秘师捆牢，便让手下都走了出去，只留下他和陈枫、公羊亮在舱内。
看到中年壮汉挣扎得厉害，一个伙计不耐烦地拿过一块砖把他敲昏了，然后丢在了一间屋子里。
没有令狐冲的见闻广博，也没有在思过崖山洞看过五岳剑派的诸般精妙剑法，直接强练独孤九剑，有种自己难为自己的意思。
“师兄，你坚持一会，我就来助你！”凌羽仙不由连连催动秘术。
目的也不仅仅这些，凌宙天早就发现自己手中除了那些个已经有了安排的清军，就没有任何可以安排的人了，至于在省城的那些人，凌宙天根本就不敢把他们寄托于大任，因为他们跟自己有什么差不多？
不言而喻，【蛇纹】的构想虽然好，但还有很多的细节需要完善。
一望无际的黄沙和岩石，太阳一直暴晒着洛天幻，在这种环境下，即便是洛天幻也有些脱水了，本来系统背包里面所留下的食物和水就并不多。
“什么？需要智慧之元？”老萧头脸色骤变，他原本想要找到进入异度时空的办法，取回异度莜草，把界蛊从那些四方族内卫身躯内逼出来，可是要是让他也如此丧心病狂的去摄取别人的智慧之元，他可做不出。
尖啸将火焰一扫而空，她痛苦地嘶鸣，猩红的眼眸瞬间转向别处。
原本墨族也是在老萧头和四方族的第二批高维化将士，现在得此时机，不如将其提前执行。
手握各种铁证，陆晨没有丝毫犹豫，直接下令查抄所有涉事官员的家产。
练气监，天下最顶尖的练气士聚集之处，同样有着浓郁的苍玄之气。
现有的主要就是骨铲，将吃完的肩胛骨绑在木头上，就能进行简单的挖掘了，虽然不是特别好用，但胜在容易制作，只要不是大工程用起来倒也能凑合。

不仅是食物，就连日常的休息对他们来说也十分困难，毕竟攻打腾蛇之时，他们身上连穿的兽皮衣服都利用上了，不少人此时还是光着膀子，白天到还好，一旦进入晚上，温度还是非常低的。
往后也只有在举办相亲大会时才会大规模行动一番，虽然这等于将交换以及相亲大会的权利全部都交给了腾蛇，但对于几个部来说，还是非常乐意接受的，毕竟从腾蛇实力壮大起来的那一刻开始，他们便已经失去了这个权利。
孙胜完白了刘奕景一眼，倒也不怕，反而是愈发挑衅的往刘奕景身上靠了靠。
保持中立，不管是驴党还是象党都不支持，而是以中立的角度，对他们进行分析，又组建了一个智囊团，由智囊团通过各个角度进行分析。
而且腾蛇竟然在周围布置了如此严密的陷阱，显然也没有想着突围出去，这些陷阱对于他们来说也不是那么容易通过的。

Chapter 2027 Mr. Butterfly (page 1)
Between the dragon and phoenix civilization sea, monks from all walks of life gathered together, like a huge grand event.
Looking around, in the dark ocean, there were at least three to four hundred thousand monks, and the sound of lively chatting resounded throughout the area.
The monks from the Treasure Palace came here with the sword world monks this time.
With the Dark Lord, the Sincere Sword Emperor, and the Chaos Son holding the battle, there is no risk at all.
Except for a table, a bed, five storage bags on the table, and a secret formation that vaguely protected the storage bags, there was nothing else in the cabin. Fang Yukun ordered his men to tie up the three secret masters in the next cabin, and then asked his men to go out, leaving only him, Chen Feng, and Gong Yangliang in the cabin.
Seeing the middle-aged man struggling fiercely, a boy impatiently took a brick and knocked him unconscious, then threw him in a room.
He didn't have Linghu Chong's extensive knowledge, nor had he seen the exquisite swordsmanship of the Wuyue Sword School in Siguoya Mountain Cave. He directly practiced the Dugu Nine Swords, which seemed to make things difficult for himself.
"Senior brother, just hold on for a while and I will come to help you!" Ling Yuxian couldn't help but activate the secret technique again and again.
The purpose is not just these. Ling Zhoutian has long discovered that he has no one to arrange except those Qing troops who have already made arrangements. As for those people in the provincial capital, Ling Zhoutian does not dare to entrust them with big tasks, because they are similar to him.
It goes without saying that although the concept of [Snake Pattern] is good, there are still many details that need to be perfected.
There was endless yellow sand and rocks, and the sun was always beating down on Luo Tianhuan. In this environment, even Luo Tianhuan was a little dehydrated. There was not much food and water left in the system backpack.
"What? Need the Essence of Wisdom?" Lao Xiaotou's expression suddenly changed. He originally wanted to find a way to enter another time and space, retrieve the alien grass, and force the world poison out of the bodies of the Sifang Clan's internal guards. However, if he were to be so frantic about absorbing the Essence of Wisdom from others, he couldn't do it.
The scream swept away the flames, she screamed in pain, and her scarlet eyes instantly turned away.
Originally, the Black Ink Clan was also the second batch of high-dimensional soldiers from the Lao Xiaotou and the Sifang Clan. Now that we have this opportunity, it is better to execute it in advance.
With all kinds of irrefutable evidence in hand, Lu Chen did not hesitate and directly ordered the property of all officials involved to be searched.
The Qi Training Supervisor, where the top Qi practitioners in the world gather, also has a strong Cangxuan Qi.
The main thing currently available is a bone shovel. You can tie the eaten shoulder blades to the wood and you can do simple digging. Although it is not particularly easy to use, it is easy to make. As long as it is not a big project, it can be used.
Not only food, but daily rest was also very difficult for them. After all, when they attacked Soaring Snake, even the animal skin clothes they wore were used. Many of them were still shirtless at this time. It was fine during the day, but once it entered the night, the temperature was still very low.
In the future, large-scale actions will only be taken when a blind date conference is held. Although this is equivalent to giving all the rights of exchange and blind date conferences to Teng She, several departments are still very happy to accept it. After all, they have lost this right from the moment Teng She became stronger.
Sun Sheng rolled his eyes at Liu Yijing, but he was not afraid. Instead, he leaned towards Liu Yijing more provocatively.
To remain neutral, neither the Donkey Party nor the Elephant Party supported it. Instead, they analyzed them from a neutral perspective and formed a think tank, which analyzed them from various angles.
Moreover, Soaring Snake actually arranged such a tight arrangement around it.traps, obviously they did not want to break out, and these traps were not so easy for them to pass.
